name: Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells special purpose vehicles, environmental equipment and systems, and car parking systems in Japan. The company offers vehicles for the construction sector, including dump, sprinkler, and concrete mixer trucks; piston type, squeeze type, stationary, high pressure and large capacity piston concrete pumps; and stationary mortar pumps. It also provides vehicles for the logistics and environmental sectors, such as tailgate lifters; tank, single car carrier, press refuse, mechanical/hydraulic operation refuse, heavy duty refuse, and container carrier trucks; and steel cargo bodies.
